MQTT::length
Description
This command gets the length of an MQTT message and is valid for all
MQTT message types.
Syntax
MQTT
::
length
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
MQTT_CLIENT_INGRESS, MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS
